name: Schembil
description: Schembil is a six-player partnership trick-taking game and variant of Briscola, played in Northern Africa and Southern Italy (especially Sicily). Two teams of three choose a captain (rais) who may direct partners; 36 cards (40-card pack minus twos), three cards each, replenish from stock after each trick.

rules.objective: As in Briscola: win tricks to score points; the team with the higher total when the stock is exhausted and all tricks are played wins the deal.
rules.gameplay:
1. Setup: Six players in two teams of three; each team chooses a captain (rais). Deal three cards to each player; turn one card for trump (briscola).
2. Play: Trick-taking as in Briscola (follow suit if possible; otherwise play any card). Winner of each trick leads next. At end of each trick, each player draws one card from the stock (winner draws first).
3. Rais: The rais of each team may ask partners questions and give orders (as in four- and six-player Briscola); only the rais may speak except when answering the rais. When stock is exhausted, the rais may look at the cards of one partner (usually to his right).
4. Scoring: Same card values as Briscola (Ace 11, Three 10, King 4, Queen 3, Jack 2); team with more points in tricks wins the deal.
